legal_status: advisory_only; Washington-qualified counsel must verify current applicability

rules.title: District behavior-based threat assessment program
rules.recommended_action: Review policy and intervention procedures with Washington-qualified counsel.
rules.rationale: RCW 28A.320.123: adopted behavior-based program; referral alone cannot justify suspension or expulsion.

rules.title: School security staff duties and complaint policy
rules.recommended_action: Update staff policy; separate school discipline from police functions; publish complaint routes.
rules.rationale: Conditional duties, role limits, and complaint process in RCW 28A.320.124.

rules.title: Security-staff reporting process
rules.recommended_action: Verify statutory collection/submission and confidentiality controls with counsel.
rules.rationale: RCW 28A.320.1241 includes prescribed reporting; sensitive details must be handled lawfully.

rules.title: Annual security provider agreement and participation
rules.recommended_action: Conduct annual agreement review including parents, students and community members.
rules.rationale: RCW 28A.320.1242 has conditional agreement and community-participation requirements.

rules.title: Bleeding control supplies, training and inspections
rules.recommended_action: Check campus equipment, staffing thresholds and inspections under RCW 28A.210.440.
rules.rationale: School-year 2026-27 requirements, with student-count-dependent staffing provisions.

rules.title: Protect lawful firearm ownership and privacy
rules.recommended_action: Do not establish school firearm-owner registries; use anonymous voluntary outreach.
rules.rationale: Safeguard adopted by the project; not a claim that all owner registries are legally prohibited.

rules.title: No demographic or political AI profiling
rules.recommended_action: Remove profiling; use documented, behavior-based evidence and independent review.
rules.rationale: Protect expression, privacy and due process.

rules.title: No autonomous authorization of physical force
rules.recommended_action: Disable autonomous force decisions; require legally authorized human judgment.
rules.rationale: A mandatory design constraint; not an assertion that an AI system is a law enforcement officer.

rules.title: Preserve safe and accessible emergency egress
rules.recommended_action: Stop barrier deployment pending fire and accessibility approval.
rules.rationale: Security must never create unsafe confinement.

rules.title: Prevent unauthorized education-record sharing
rules.recommended_action: Block unlawful access, preserve logs, and involve counsel for applicable privacy law.
rules.rationale: A safeguard against misuse of school data, not a blanket ban on lawful reporting.

rules.title: No unverified remote physical actuation
rules.recommended_action: Require authenticated commands, independent testing, and manual fallback.

rules.title: Specialist canine program must be qualified
rules.recommended_action: Suspend unqualified canine program and arrange specialist independent assessment.
rules.rationale: Canine screening is not validated as a universal school-shooting countermeasure.

rules.title: AI cannot directly modify verified rules
rules.recommended_action: Use versioned change control and human-reviewed rule updates.
rules.rationale: Symbolic policy layer must not be silently rewritten by an LLM.

rules.title: Human review and fair process for adverse actions
rules.recommended_action: Require corroboration, appeal/correction path, and trained decision maker.
rules.rationale: Prevent malicious reports and mistaken irreversible actions.

rules.title: Lawful and documented authority for on-site response
rules.recommended_action: Hold implementation until authorization, qualified staffing and independent oversight are documented.
rules.rationale: Public recommendation guidance, no tactical force instructions.

rules.title: Threat-driven evaluation before connected technology deployment
rules.recommended_action: Pilot against threat-specific requirements and independently test cyber-physical failure modes.
rules.rationale: Technology adoption follows identified risk and must preserve safe operation.

rules.title: Independent alert validation
rules.recommended_action: Validate misses and false alarms; keep people responsible for emergency decisions.
rules.rationale: No claimed product accuracy without independent test evidence.

rules.title: Privacy-preserving youth access outreach
rules.recommended_action: Use optional secure-storage education and anonymous impact reporting.
rules.rationale: Promote safeguards without compulsory ownership disclosure.
